name: alps
description: Design recurring or shared agent work as a reusable, assessable Process Skill with an explicit Purpose, observable Outcomes, and only necessary guidance.

interface.longDescription: ALPS applies the Process Framework to Agent Skills. It helps design recurring or shared agent work as one reusable, assessable Process Skill with an explicit Purpose, observable Outcomes, and only necessary guidance. Skill discovery and execution remain Host responsibilities, while adoption and governance remain repository or organizational responsibilities.
capabilities: Define explicit Purpose and observable Outcomes
Review and revise reusable Process Skills
defaultPrompt: Use $reusable-work-design to turn this recurring or shared agent work into a reusable Process Skill with an explicit Purpose, observable Outcomes, and only the guidance needed to apply it.
